## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for the user or contributor?

Related issue/spec/task:

## Verification

Commands/checks run, results, and anything not run with its reason:

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is small and acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; changed behavior has automated tests and bug fixes have regression tests, or this is a documentation/configuration-only change.
- [ ] Affected docs and significant architecture decisions are recorded.
- [ ] Raw player data is excluded; source-data access remains read-only and non-executing where relevant.
- [ ] Owner acceptance is recorded before merging; an agent has explicit merge authorization if performing the merge.
